entries.426a86f5741aa29d: Under the medium-term management plan 'CONNECT 2030' announced on April 8, 2026, the group states that it will implement measures aimed at continuing to put customers first and pursuing sustainable growth, co-creating new value with customers, and accelerating DX investment and strengthening its financial base, under the slogan 'KUTSUROGI' to connect people, communities and the world. As priority issues to address, it lists pursuing Komeda-style full service, accelerating store expansion with a focus on profitability, and strengthening in-house manufacturing to thoroughly ensure safety and security and improve productivity; it also aims to establish a system of more than 50 Okage-an stores through strengthened store openings, fully launch FC expansion in its overseas markets, and develop new countries mainly in ASEAN.

entries.8efa6c792b22754b: A holding company headquartered in Higashi-ku, Nagoya, which operates coffee shop and restaurant chains together with 8 consolidated subsidiaries. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended February 2026 is 828.
entries.94189a378c051045: Komeda Co., Ltd. runs an FC business of coffee shops under the brands "Kohi-dokoro Komeda Coffee Ten" and "OkageAn", and for FC members it selects store properties, provides know-how for the design and construction of store buildings and interiors, gives coffee shop operation guidance, manufactures and wholesales food materials, and subleases store buildings. Ryukyu Komeda Co., Ltd. operates directly managed stores mainly in Okinawa Prefecture, and Komeda Commerce Co., Ltd. operates directly managed stores mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area under brands such as "Hamburger & Sandwich Beisu" and "BLUE LEAF CAFÉ". Revenue from external customers of the segment is ¥51,374 million.
entries.a95637ecf352c784: Its strengths are its original store format that prioritizes relaxation, and its original FC system, which maintains the motivation of FC franchisee operators through a fixed-fee royalty proportional to the number of seats and a highly flexible store operating policy. Other features include a supply structure in which its main products, coffee and bread, are delivered directly from its own factories to stores, reducing distribution costs and intermediate margins, and store locations concentrated in suburban residential areas, which makes competition with other coffee chains less likely to arise.
entries.ab679da2bcbbb854: For FC Franchisees and Customers of the Stores
entries.d3de1782ee27b894: A holding company headquartered in Higashi Ward, Nagoya, forming a group of the company and 8 consolidated subsidiaries. In Japan, it operates FC businesses and directly managed stores of full-service coffee shops under the brands "Kohi-dokoro Komeda Coffee Ten" and "OkageAn"; overseas, it operates "Kohi-dokoro Komeda Coffee Ten" in Taiwan, Shanghai, Hong Kong and Indonesia, and restaurants such as "Kaffe & Toast" and "Saap Saap Thai" in Singapore. There are 2 reportable segments, the domestic business and the overseas business; the number of employees in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was 828, and the number of stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year was 1,150.
entries.d6883e94ccabcc3d: In Japan, the company operates 1,067 stores, mainly FC franchised stores, and overseas it operates 83 stores in Taiwan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Indonesia and Singapore; the number of stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year is 1,150.
